facts.fact: Maroc Telecom's 5,700 km transafrican terrestrial cable from Morocco to Niger via Mauritania, Mali and Burkina Faso, recorded as completed in 2022, lets Moov Africa Niger connect to international bandwidth via the Maroc Telecom network (deal record for the e& financing; the record's own 'Connects to submarine cable at CIV and TGO' note is not a Niger landing).
